item.title: Alabama House passes bill requiring reporting parents whose children smell of marijuana
item.description: The House of Representatives passed a bill Thursday requiring certain people to report parents whose children smell like marijuana smoke.

item.title: Alabama Senate passes bill prohibiting elder abusers from profiting from deaths
item.description: The Senate Thursday also passed Sen. Keith Kelley’s Senate Bill 41 to prohibit people who are convicted of elder abuse and neglect or financial exploitation of an elderly person from profiting from that person’s death.

item.title: Disaster relief volunteers work in Mississippi after winter storm, in Alabama after tornado, winds
item.description: After a winter storm swept across north Mississippi in late January — at the same time a tornado and straight-line winds affected south Alabama — Alabama Baptist Disaster Relief teams are hard at work.

item.title: Senior artist encourages believers to give brush to God
item.description: Wesley Dickmann’s life changed in a “miracle year for me,” said the 82-year-old artist and minister.

item.title: First person: Eye contact and a few smiles will be a win
item.description: Fun note — I get to share with an assembly of students at my alma mater, Phil Campbell High School, in a few weeks.

item.title: Opinion: War respects worship and America should too
item.description: There is a troubling silence surrounding the recent disruption of a Sunday worship service at a church in Minnesota. That silence deserves scrutiny, not because of the personalities involved, but because of the principle at stake.

item.title: Lance announces upcoming retirement plans from Alabama Baptist State Board of Missions
item.description: Rick Lance began serving with the Alabama Baptist State Board of Missions in 1998 and has served more than 55 years total in Alabama Baptist churches and ministry positions.

item.title: Roger Houston, pastor of Hook Street Baptist, dies at 74
item.description: Roger Houston, pastor of Hook Street Baptist Church in Tuscumbia, died Jan. 28 after almost five decades of pastoral ministry at several Alabama churches and a long career in education.
